newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Sept qtr gas production up 16.1 pct on year ago.
newsitem.headline: NZ Sept qtr gas production up 16.1 pct on year ago.

text.p: New Zealand gas production in the September quarter was up 16.1 percent on the September 1995 quarter, at 66,589 terajoules, Statistics New Zealand said on Tuesday.
Releasing its September quarter production statistics, SNZ said gas production for the year ended September was up 10.7 percent on the previous year.
Total electricity generation in the quarter showed no change from the year-ago quarter, while production of petrol was down 17.3 percent compared to the September 1995 quarter.

The number of cigarettes available for consumption in the quarter was up 15.1 percent on the year-ago quarter, while over the same period the quantity of tobacco available for consumption fell 11.4 percent.
However, over the September year cigarettes available for consumption fell five percent and tobacco fell 9.4 percent compared with the September 1995 year.
Footwear production in the quarter was down 18.7 percent on the September 1995 quarter, to the lowest level in a September quarter since 1975, when the series began.
Total livestock slaughtered in the quarter was up 1.4 percent on a year ago, while carpet production rose 16.1 percent.
